component.name: Flathub Catalog Installer
component.summary: Select many Flathub apps and install them with one command

description.p: Flathub Catalog Installer loads the Flathub application catalog, lets you search it, tick multiple applications, and installs all selected apps in a single Flatpak operation.
It is especially useful after a fresh Linux installation or when setting up several machines the same way: save the selected app list to a file once, restore it anywhere.
Help and About dialogs, app icon and artwork, desktop integration files, AppImage/Flatpak/pip packaging.
Package layout, pagination, dark mode, installed detection, scope switch, save/load selections, CLI mode.
